comments.author: Shazflag
comments.body: The actual requirement for this title is to complete the Oxford mini-storyline. That requires submitting a total of 100 theses, but it also requires you to go to Oxford each time they tell you to. So once they start telling you to visit the college, go there immediately and get the cutscene with Justine, etc. Repeat this process until all cutscenes have been viewed and you'll get the title.
